response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their professional profile centers on web and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), with only a brief ~6-month professional C++ stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015. The role demands deep, current C++/STL expertise, industrial automation experience, and IEC 62443 secure development practices — none of which are substantively evidenced. Adjacent systems experience (low-latency DLang microservices, event-driven architecture) is interesting but insufficient for a senior C++ role in industrial cybersecurity contexts.
strengths: Solid low-level/systems experience via high-performance, low-latency DLang microservices handling millions of requests per second
Event-driven architecture and distributed systems exposure, plus strong testing and software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Mentoring and knowledge-sharing track record through workshops, courses, and code dojos
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience — only a short stint a decade ago; C++ not even listed in skills section
No industrial automation, IoT protocol (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA), or IEC 62443 / SDL security experience
Career trajectory has moved consistently toward web/full-stack and AI tooling, away from the embedded/industrial domain this role requires
